audit_metadata.report_title: Phase 3: Field-Data Readiness and Classifier Reliability Audit
audit_metadata.auditor: Senior Computer-Vision Engineer & Mineral-Data Quality Auditor

executive_readiness_assessment.primary_deficiency: Total absence of laboratory-verified physical mineral specimens with chemical/mineralogical assay confirmation in the training, validation, and test splits.
executive_readiness_assessment.production_gatekeeper_status: Baseline MineralConvNet preserved. OOD threshold 5.0 enforced. Production weights untouched.

cross_split_near_duplicate_leakage_dhash.note: Perceptual dHash proximity on synthetic noise patterns

duplicates_and_data_leakage.evaluation_mirroring_note: data/evaluation/known contains 80 files mirroring validation and test sets as a known-class benchmark.
duplicates_and_data_leakage.upload_redundancy_note: data/uploads contains 250 duplicate files generated by automated API tests and repeated user upload attempts.

feedback_queue_quarantine_audit.quarantine_compliance: 100.0% COMPLIANT — Zero unverified feedback records ingested into training data.

missing_metadata_and_verification_requir.laboratory_assays: Missing for 100% of specimens (0/3 physical specimens have XRF, XRD, or wet-chemical verification).
missing_metadata_and_verification_requir.physical_specimen_ids: Historically missing; now cataloged with explicit specimen IDs or null for synthetic textures.
missing_metadata_and_verification_requir.acquisition_parameters: Missing camera sensor data, optical EXIF, illuminant temperature, and distance for all field uploads.
missing_metadata_and_verification_requir.geological_provenance: Missing host rock lithology, formation, mining lease, and geographic coordinates for all 3 uploads.

tier_1_core_economic_minerals.objective: Acquire 50-100 physical specimens per target class (200-400 total) from authentic Indian mining belts.
tier_1_core_economic_minerals.mandatory_verification: Certified laboratory assay: XRF elemental analysis (% Fe, % Mn, % Al2O3, % SiO2) and XRD mineralogy.

conditions: Fresh fracture face under diffuse daylight
Directional sunlight for luster/specular highlight characterization
Wet / misted surface for sub-surface refraction
tier_2_photographic_protocol.color_and_scale_standards: Calibrated 18% neutral gray card and centimeter scale bar in frame; raw DNG + lossless JPEG.

tier_3_negative_benchmark_ood_rocks.objective: Acquire 25 assayed physical specimens each of country rock and gangue lithologies.

tier_4_partitioning_governance.rule: Group-based physical specimen splitting. All images of a given physical specimen ID are restricted to a single split (Train: 70%, Val: 15%, Test: 15%).

remaining_risks_and_guardrails: Risk of False Generalization: The existing classifier achieves 100% test accuracy solely on synthetic texture patches; evaluating on real field photos without verified field training data produces out-of-distribution rejections.
Risk of OOD Threshold Dilution: Relaxing the OOD threshold (tau = 5.0) to force acceptance of unverified photos admits non-target rocks (as demonstrated by ResNet-18 admitting quartz and limestone).
Risk of Feedback Pollution: Promoting unverified user feedback into training without XRF/XRD assay corrupts model decision boundaries.
